page.title: Email & notifications
page.description: Configure provider-neutral SMTP delivery and verify that CompassAQ can send administrator email.

not_configured.label: Not configured
not_configured.explanation: CompassAQ does not yet have saved email delivery settings.
not_configured.nextAction: Enter and save the SMTP, sender, and recipient settings.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.explanation: Email settings are saved, but CompassAQ will not send email while delivery is disabled.
disabled.nextAction: Edit the configuration and enable delivery when you are ready.

needs_attention.label: Needs attention
needs_attention.explanation: The saved configuration needs another step before email delivery is ready.
needs_attention.nextAction: Review the issue below, then save or retry the delivery test.

ready.label: Ready
ready.explanation: The saved configuration has completed a successful delivery test.
ready.nextAction: No action is required. You can send another test at any time.

reasons.emailNotConfigured: Email delivery has not been configured.
reasons.smtpSecurityModeMissing: Choose how the SMTP connection is secured.
reasons.administratorRecipientsMissing: Add at least one administrator recipient.
reasons.smtpCredentialsIncomplete: Enter both the SMTP username and password, or leave both unused for a network-authenticated relay.
reasons.unencryptedCredentialsNotAllowed: Username and password authentication cannot be used with unencrypted SMTP.
reasons.testRequired: Save is complete. Send a test email to verify delivery.
reasons.lastTestFailed: The last delivery test failed. Review the configuration and try again.

errors.loadFailed: Email configuration could not be loaded. Check the API connection and try again.
errors.saveFailed: Email configuration could not be saved. Review the fields and try again.
errors.testFailed: CompassAQ could not send the test email. Review the configuration and try again.
errors.unknown: The saved email configuration needs attention.
errors.emailConfigurationDisabled: Email delivery is disabled. Enable and save it before testing.
errors.emailConfigurationIncomplete: The saved configuration is incomplete. Review the required connection, sender, and recipient fields.
errors.smtpSecretUnavailable: The saved SMTP password cannot be read. Restore the CompassAQ encryption key or replace the password.
errors.smtpDnsFailure: The SMTP server name could not be found. Check the server hostname and network DNS.
errors.smtpConnectionTimeout: The SMTP server did not respond in time. Check the hostname, port, firewall, and network path.
errors.smtpConnectionFailed: CompassAQ could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the hostname, port, and network access.
errors.smtpTlsError: The secure SMTP connection failed. Check the security mode and the server certificate.
errors.smtpAuthenticationFailed: The SMTP server rejected the saved username or password. Replace the credentials and try again.
errors.smtpSenderRejected: The SMTP server rejected the sender address. Verify that the From address is authorized by your email service.
errors.smtpRecipientRejected: The SMTP server rejected the test recipient. Verify the address and any provider restrictions.
errors.smtpRelayDenied: The SMTP server would not relay this message. Check authentication and relay permissions.
errors.smtpServerDisconnected: The SMTP server disconnected before delivery completed. Check the server and try again.
errors.smtpServerError: The SMTP server returned an unexpected error. Check the provider service and try again.
errors.invalidEmailMessage: CompassAQ could not build a valid test message. Review the sender and recipient addresses.

validation.required: This field is required while email delivery is enabled.
validation.invalidText: Enter valid text or leave the field blank.
validation.invalidControlCharacter: Remove line breaks or unsupported control characters.
validation.invalidSmtpHost: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL scheme, path, or spaces.
validation.invalidSecurityMode: Choose a supported SMTP security mode.
validation.invalidRecipients: Administrator recipients must be a list of email addresses.
validation.tooManyRecipients: No more than 50 administrator recipients are allowed.
validation.recipientRequired: Add at least one administrator recipient while email delivery is enabled.
validation.invalidEnabledState: Choose whether email delivery is enabled.
validation.invalidPassword: Enter a valid SMTP password or deliberately clear it.
validation.emptyPassword: Enter a non-empty replacement password. Use Clear password to remove the saved password.
validation.passwordTooLong: The SMTP password must not exceed 4096 characters.
validation.credentialsTogether: SMTP username and password must be configured together.
validation.unencryptedCredentials: Clear the username and saved password before using unencrypted SMTP.

security.warningTitle: This connection will not be encrypted.
security.warningDescription: Use this mode only for a trusted network relay. CompassAQ does not allow username or password authentication over an unencrypted connection.

confirmDialog.title: Save unencrypted SMTP?
confirmDialog.description: Messages and connection metadata may be readable on the network. Confirm that this server is a trusted relay that does not require username or password authentication.

password.writeOnlyHelp: CompassAQ never returns the saved password. Unrelated changes preserve it automatically.
password.inputHelp: The password is sent only when you save and is never shown again.

clearDialog.title: Clear the saved SMTP password?
clearDialog.description: The password will be removed when you save the configuration. SMTP authentication will not work until a new password is saved.

delivery.title: Delivery control
delivery.description: Choose whether CompassAQ may send email using this saved configuration.
delivery.enabledHelp: Disable delivery without deleting the saved connection, sender, or recipients.

smtp.title: SMTP connection
smtp.description: Enter the standard SMTP settings supplied by your email service, such as Amazon SES, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Exchange, SendGrid, or Mailgun.
smtp.hostHelp: Hostname or IP address only; do not include smtp://, https://, or a path.
smtp.portHelp: Common values are 587 for STARTTLS and 465 for SSL/TLS. Use the port supplied by your provider.
smtp.securityHelp: STARTTLS upgrades the connection before authentication. SSL/TLS is encrypted from connection start.
smtp.usernameHelp: Optional for a network-authenticated relay; otherwise configure it together with a password.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: This identity appears in the From header of administrator email.
sender.replyToHelp: Optional address that receives replies instead of the From address.

recipients.title: Administrator recipients
recipients.description: These addresses are the default recipients for future administrator notifications.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: Identity used for outgoing administrator email.

test.title: Test delivery
test.description: Send a clearly labeled CompassAQ test using the exact saved configuration.
test.recipientHelp: Defaults to the first saved administrator recipient. Enter another address for this test only.
test.unsavedChanges: Save or cancel your changes before testing. Tests always use the saved configuration.
test.disabled: Enable and save email delivery before sending a test.

administratorSummary.title: Administrator summary
administratorSummary.description: Send administrators a concise digest of data imports, quality-control activity, and important system events for each completed reporting period.

summary_off.label: Summary off
summary_off.explanation: Scheduled administrator summaries are not being sent. You can still preview a completed reporting period.

blocked_email_delivery.label: Blocked
blocked_email_delivery.explanation: The schedule is saved, but summaries cannot send until Email Delivery is ready.

waiting_for_first_scheduled_period.label: Waiting for first period
waiting_for_first_scheduled_period.explanation: The schedule is active. CompassAQ is waiting for the first completed reporting period after this schedule took effect.

last_summary_sent.label: Last summary sent
last_summary_sent.explanation: The latest scheduled summary was sent. The next completed period remains scheduled.

last_summary_failed.label: Last summary failed
last_summary_failed.explanation: CompassAQ could not send the latest scheduled summary. This does not necessarily mean the SMTP service is unavailable.

delivery_unknown.label: Delivery outcome unknown
delivery_unknown.explanation: CompassAQ cannot confirm whether this summary was delivered. It will not resend it automatically to avoid a duplicate.

delivery_in_progress.label: Delivery in progress
delivery_in_progress.explanation: CompassAQ has started the latest scheduled delivery and is waiting for its outcome.

facts.label: Administrator summary schedule at a glance

form.title: Schedule
form.description: Choose one reporting cadence and timezone. Changes begin with future completed periods and do not send older summaries.
form.enabledHelp: Send the selected digest automatically when Email Delivery is ready.
form.cadenceLegend: How often should CompassAQ summarize activity?
form.sendTimeHelp: A summary sent at {{time}} reports on the previous calendar day in this timezone.
form.systemTimezoneHelp: Inherited from System Preferences. Changing the system timezone updates this summary unless you choose an override.
form.timezoneHelp: Reporting periods and schedule times use this IANA timezone.

daily.label: Daily
daily.periodHelp: Each email summarizes the previous completed local calendar day.

hourly.label: Hourly
hourly.help: An advanced operational cadence for closer monitoring.
hourly.periodHelp: Each email summarizes the previous completed hour.

every15.label: Testing — every 15 minutes
every15.help: A commissioning cadence for short, closely monitored tests.
every15.periodHelp: Each email summarizes the previous completed 15-minute period.
every15.warning: This cadence can generate frequent email. Use it only for testing or commissioning, then return to Daily.

advanced.title: Advanced / Testing
advanced.help: Use these cadences only when administrators need more frequent operational summaries.

preview.title: Summary preview
preview.notSent: This preview uses current database data for a completed period. No email was sent and scheduled delivery was not changed.
preview.subject: Email subject

test.blocked: Send test summary becomes available when Email Delivery above is Ready.
test.unsaved: Save the summary schedule before sending a test. Preview can use unsaved selections.
test.dialogDescription: CompassAQ will build the actual summary and send a clearly marked test. It will not count as a scheduled delivery.
test.recipientHelp: Leave blank to use the first saved administrator recipient, or enter a one-time address. This address will not be saved.

errors.loadFailed: Administrator summary settings could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.saveFailed: The administrator summary schedule could not be saved. Review the settings and try again.
errors.previewFailed: CompassAQ could not build the summary preview. Try again.
errors.testFailed: CompassAQ could not send the test summary. Review Email Delivery and try again.

workflow.deliveryDescription: Configure how CompassAQ sends administrator email.
workflow.setupHelp: Set up SMTP, sender, and recipients to enable administrator email.
workflow.retry: Review the delivery error and retry the test
workflow.summaryDescription: Uses your configured email delivery to send scheduled summaries to administrator recipients.
